threepl.simulator

Class SimTraceDetails

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimDetails
      • threepl.simulator.SimTraceDetails

  • public class SimTraceDetails
extends SimDetails
    This class stores trace setup details. It handles trace data logging, retrieval and display via the SimTraceLogger class. SimTraceLogger interacts with the SimTerminal class to handle the display.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh

      • writeSample

        protected void writeSample(double time)
        Evaluate and write current expression values to trace log file as a single line String. If any runtime error(s) occur during expression evaluation, the offending result(s) are replaced by the substring "" within the result String, and an exception is thrown after writing the completed line to the log file.
